testcase.name: an unmeasurable slot yields instead of guessing
all five primary labels fit their slot at the reference configuration
a mis-ordered measurement list is rejected rather than silently mis-picked
a narrow slot steps down instead of clipping the label
the chosen size is always one that fits, or the caller is told none does
the largest fitting size wins, not the smallest
below the floor the entry degrades to icon-only rather than to a fragment
a size that exactly fills the slot is a fit
